tolerance_rationale: Ephemeris drift (Python FLG_SWIEPH/JPL vs TS FLG_MOSEPH/Moshier) gives ~2e-4 hr end-time differences; the next-yogam quad re-evaluates at jd + end_time (Python's hours-vs-days quirk, replicated in TS), so each side evaluates at a point offset by its own end-time. At ~15 deg/day combined Moon+Sun yoga speed this amplifies the seed difference ~10x. 5e-3 hr = 18 s bound. Discrete outputs (yogam numbers) match exactly.
